frozen_before: any evaluation run carrying code_hash from 2026-09-12 onward; the values below were written before the multi-dataset coefficient probe and the next staged run were executed
source: proposed by the round 7 review of 2026-09-12, adopted unchanged
note: three verdicts are computed separately and one never implies another. Changing any number here after seeing a result invalidates that result as evidence; add a new entry with a new frozen_at date instead.

implementation.what_it_asks: the manuscript-aligned training path runs, data roles are separated, the objective and the error decomposition are the ones defined in Sections 2 to 4, and every result file carries verifiable provenance
checks: both training modes complete a run from encoder updates through checkpoint selection
evaluation rows never fitted a critic parameter or selected a checkpoint
population D2 holds out T = (X, W_S) and tau_Z is computed for every comparator
every result file passes provenance.verify with checkpoint digests

diagnosis.what_it_asks: the four sources of representation error can be told apart on the same data
sources: population objective does not distinguish r
finite-sample objective with true probabilities does not distinguish r
the optimizer does not reach the minimum of its own objective

development_gate.statistic: |tau_Z - 1|, the population adjusted effect of the learned representation minus the true effect
development_gate.at: the largest representation sample size in the run
development_gate.replicate_unit: independent data seed; optimizer seeds are within-replicate variation and are never counted as replicates

performance.scope: a fixed-block, one-coefficient success is evidence about the Section 4 learning problem only. Algorithm 1 searching and combining unknown blocks is a separate verification.
